messages:
maria: Hey team — final checklist for tomorrow's Canary launch (09:00 PT). Who's able to run the deploy and monitor smoke for the first 30m?
kevin: I can do the deploy. I'll be available at 08:45 PT to start the rollout.
sam: I'll own the smoke checks and metrics dashboard watch (alerts on latency/error-rate).
jess: Product will be standing by for feature flag toggles and to validate UX on a few flows.
nina: CS is prepped with the short FAQ. I'll shadow the first hour and jump on any customer threads.
oliver: Marketing — we'll send the customer-facing note 1 hour after canary passes. I'll queue the email and social drafts now.
maria: Awesome. Quick confirmation: rollback readiness? kevin, do you have the previous image & helm rollback ready?
kevin: Yes — `image:v2.3.4` is tagged and rollback playbook is in the repo. I'll keep a terminal open and a hotfix branch ready.
sam: Smoke checklist (I'll run):
```
- hit /health and /v1/generate (10 reqs each)
- validate 95th p95 latency < 250ms for small prompt
- run 5 sample end-to-end prompts via staging-key
- check KV cache hit-rate and redis errors
- verify logs for any OOM/alloc warnings
```
maria: Perfect. Nina/jess — can you confirm support playbook link and the internal release notes?
nina: Support playbook: https://intranet.redwood/support/playbooks/launchs — updated this morning with triage steps and escalation matrix.
jess: Internal release notes draft is at https://confluence.redwood/eng/releases/17798 — includes known limitations and feature-flag gating.
oliver: For external release note, we'll include the short blurb + opt-in beta CTA. We'll wait for go-ahead after canary.
maria: Timeout/abort criteria for canary? Sam, suggest we abort if error rate > 1% or p95 > 600ms for 3 consecutive 1-min windows. Agree?
sam: Agree. Also abort if model outputs regress on the top 3 eval prompt sets (I'll have the eval harness ready to run).
kevin: I'll hold the k8s rollout at 25% for first 10m, then 50% for 10m, then 100% if everything green. Manual proceed on each step.
maria: Communication plan: I'll post an update in #eng-releases at each major step (deploy started, canary=green, full rollout, rollback if any). Nina/Oliver, please standby for customer comms sync.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by kevin for 2026-03-18T09:00:00-07:00. Rollback window: 30m after completion.
nina: Got it — CS on standby. I'll add answers to the top-cases in the shared doc.
oliver: I'll be watching the canary metrics too. If we see any oddness we hold and don't send external notes.
maria: Thanks all — kevin, ping here when you start the deploy and again when canary passes. Sam, add short smoke summary (pass/fail + any anomalies).
kevin: Will do. Ready to roll. :rocket:
maria: Nice. Let's keep comms concise during the window. See you all at 08:45 PT in case we need a quick voice check.
